name: PMO KPI Performance
query: SELECT r.name AS "Reading:Link/PMO KPI Reading:180", r.kpi AS "KPI:Link/PMO KPI:180", r.period AS "Period:Data:120", r.actual_value AS "Actual:Float:110", r.target_value AS "Target:Float:110", r.achievement_percent AS "Achievement %:Percent:120", r.status AS "Status:Data:100", r.reading_date AS "Reading Date:Date:110" FROM `tabPMO KPI Reading` r ORDER BY r.reading_date DESC, r.kpi
